translation_snapshot.source:
You accurately jump to the target and deal 200%% weapon damage to all foes within radius 1 on impact as well as dazing them for 3 turns.
		When you jump you free yourself from any stun, daze and pinning effects.
translation_snapshot.target:
你跃向目标地点，对 1 码半径范围内的所有敌人造成 200%% 的武器伤害，并使它们眩晕 3 回合。
		落地后，你解除自身眩晕、定身和震慑效果。

translation_snapshot.source: Use it if you want normal playing conditions but do not feel ready for just one life.#{normal}#
translation_snapshot.target: 如果还没有准备好一条命通关就用这个模式进行。#{normal}#

translation_snapshot.source: The art of calling creatures adept in elemental destruction to your aid.
translation_snapshot.target: 召唤远程元素攻击类生物来协助你战斗的艺术。
